_note: Config for the two similarity probes: scripts/test_similarity_few_shot.py (eyeball the top-k neighbours of a handful of probe questions) and scripts/test_similarity_router.py (three-way raw/masked comparison scored by majority vote). v1 hard-coded the model registry, the k values, the majority-vote window and - in test_similarity_few_shot.py - the probe questions themselves. The first probe question below is fabricated: v1's first probe was a verbatim row from its MetaQA eval question file, and a probe should not be built from an evaluation row. v1 also appended a fifth probe read at runtime from the first line of that same eval file; that dynamic case was dropped for the same reason, so the probe list is fully declared here.
